baseline: 9da436bfac; already includes the nonEmptyPriorities/peekHead removal requested before this review
scope: All tracked flexlb source. Foreign untracked replacement classes were preserved and excluded from isolated builds.
method: Enumerated every tracked production Java source declaration using the JDK AST, including nested classes, records and interfaces.

Cross-checked compiled main/test references including inheritance, interface dispatch, lambdas and method references. Manually followed deletion candidates into callers, framework callbacks and internal-source consumers.
Checked Python AST definitions against repository-wide references, retaining decorator registrations and protocol callbacks.
limits: Reference inventories are evidence for candidate selection, not a proof that every live method is ideally designed or every interleaving is correct.
Field counts include enum values and record components; method counts include constructors.
Compiler-inlined constants, framework callbacks, serializers and external implementations cannot be judged by bytecode reference count alone.
Tests may inspect canonical state without justifying a separately maintained production index.
design_constraints: Identify the authoritative owner, real readers, update points and synchronization rule for each mutable state.
Keep derived state only when index/cache value and coherent invalidation justify it.
Expose consumer operations in interfaces; keep implementation helpers private.
Test actual scans, wait registration and delivery order rather than test-only indexes or a quiet-time inference.
Verify framework lifecycle with an actual container and retain idempotent resource-transfer boundaries.

interfaces.necessity: Routing reads candidate cache matches; sync updates and retires engine cache. Keep the implementation boundary.

EngineLocalView reports diff statistics and the poller reads the shared interval. Removed the unused instance passed through three sync layers; the existing shared interval remains. Initialization still follows DefaultCacheAwareService -> KvCacheManager -> EngineLocalView -> DynamicCacheIntervalService; removing the unused injection chain does not remove the real dependency.
Expression-tree nodes share evaluation while constants, variables and operators have different implementations.
Production consumers query, subscribe and shut down local or internal discovery providers.
Discovery implementations invoke this callback when endpoints change.
Immutable tags shared by Micrometer and the internal kmonitor adapter.
Reporter boundary with multiple monitoring implementations. Optional prepare/close defaults are intentional capabilities.
Actually consumed by internal_source/java/kmonitor KMonitorAdapter; retain both providers even though the opensource reactor has no direct call.
PriorityOrdering reads normalized priority and stable FIFO sequence across queue item types.
Starts concrete gRPC address resolvers.
Resolver callback updates channel addresses.
Control endpoints share target selection, parsing, error handling and response formatting while supplying different mutations.
Nonblocking capacity query plus listener registration/removal; removal prevents retained waiters.
BATCH and NON_BATCH have different admission and transport behavior; common transactions avoid mode branches at every caller.
Prepare, canonical commit, handoff and abort/close represent distinct ownership stages.
DIRECT owns no active queue; QUEUE owns an ordered index shared with the canonical ledger.
Real and mock cancel transport implementations; cancel acceptance is distinct from resource retirement.
One pure planner reads live and projected items without copying the algorithm.
Formula and learned prediction implementations share prediction and model-update behavior.
A planning operation uses one immutable model; snapshot identity allows prediction reuse without conflating endpoint state.
Pure projection behavior remains paired with the actual delivery mode.
Lazily predicts only the candidate prefix needed by the probe.
Keep primitives consumed by delivery projections; moved two implementation-only operations to private methods.
Member completion time and complete preceding-group duration serve different projection questions.
Reused invocation-local result avoids fleet-wide result allocation; removed the unused required-TTFT default query.
Dispatch permit is acquired before commit, transferred on submit, or released on close.
Capacity/topology events wake waiters. Removed unread event sequence; real version indexes remain.
Routing only needs consistency-enabled and leader status. Removed unused lifecycle operations from this read-only interface; connected concrete destruction to Spring.

retained_state_reviews.reason: inFlight bounds planner ownership; completedPlans carries completion events; pendingPriorities drives real scans. Waiting and retrying are different scheduling stages. Removed the unused all-entry priority index.

Queue, scheduling-input and ownership versions cover independent changes. Coherent snapshots and immutable derived arrays avoid rescanning each endpoint for every route. Retain versioned caching rather than deleting it as duplicate state.
Discovery observations, exact generation pins, Master reservations and engine-reported ownership are not interchangeable. Retirement and rediscovery must remain generation-fenced.

Registration, admission, delivery, terminal settlement and completion publication cross asynchronous ownership boundaries. Close and cancellation need idempotence and reentrancy handling. Removed dead dependencies and queries, not lifecycle distinctions.
Engine-to-block and block-to-engine indexes answer different queries; windowing and sharding serve sampling and concurrency rather than redundant ownership.
Several constant field reads are compiler-inlined. Source and generated getters still use the values; zero GETFIELD references do not justify removal.
Configuration, protocol and error data retain Jackson/Lombok/external contracts. Removed unused handwritten factories without removing data properties.
Live capacity gates, cumulative metrics and terminal history have different semantics. Keep actual control/observation counters; remove unconsumed queries.
